title: Test post - Pythagorean Theorem
text:
The Pythagorean theorem states that in a right triangle with legs of length \(a\) and \(b\) and hypotenuse of length \(c\), \[
a^2 + b^2 = c^2.
\]
A simple example is \(a=3\), \(b=4\), \(c=5\), since \(3^2 + 4^2 = 9 + 16 = 25 = 5^2\).

  
  
  a = 3
  b = 4
  c = 5
